title: Saturday, October 24
line: A morning with the people of this community. Free, all welcome.

blocks.title: Network and get seated
blocks.note: Say hello and find a seat.

blocks.title: Introductions
blocks.note: Your first name, one community you belong to, and one thing you would put on a page of your own. About 30 seconds each.

blocks.title: What is Hypercomb
blocks.note: People first. An open protocol nobody owns. Every thing has a fingerprint, so peers can check it and everyone can serve it. Host your own domain and content.

blocks.title: Join the room
blocks.note: Scan the code, open the link, say yes to join.

blocks.title: The tutorial
blocks.note: The host says start tutorial. Tap Join on the panel at the top, and the explanation plays itself — everyone moving page to page together.

blocks.title: Q and A
blocks.note: Ask, answer, and take the answers you like. The host's tally scores them.

blocks.title: Discussion
blocks.note: Talk through what came up in the questions: what surprised you, and what you would build.
